prevention.ref: Counterexamples to naturality require a concrete object and an endomorphism that moves every candidate choice.

evidence.note: The repaired carrier computes the degree-one UCT sequence for an explicit free complex over Z with Z/2 coefficients and shows that a homology-trivial shear moves both possible sections.
The synchronized contract records the explicit UCT calculation, shear action, and exhaustive section contradiction.
The repaired disposition records that the former schematic complement argument named neither a complex nor a coefficient group.

prevention.ref: A change of a noncanonical complement does not refute naturality unless a concrete naturality square fails.

evidence.note: The repaired counterexample gives a chain automorphism acting identically on both UCT outer terms and by a fixed-point-free shear on all quotient sections.
The synchronized contract records the concrete complex, coefficient group, outer-term action, and contradiction for every section.
The repaired disposition records that the former proof inferred nonnaturality from an unspecified changed complement.

prevention.ref: A false canonical-splitting claim requires an explicit pair of complexes and a naturality obstruction.

evidence.note: The repaired refutation computes a degree-one Kunneth middle group (Z/2)^2 and a homology-trivial shear that fixes the outer terms while moving every section.
The synchronized contract records the middle-homology computation, shear action, and exhaustive section argument.
The repaired disposition records that the former refutation asserted noncanonicity without any witnessing pair of complexes.

prevention.ref: A refutation of an arbitrary-ideal Tor formula must exhibit a nonprincipal ideal where the kernel differs from the annihilator.

evidence.note: The repaired refutation uses R=k[x,y], I=(x,y), and M=k, obtaining Tor_1(R/I,k)=I/I^2 of dimension two while the I-annihilator of k has dimension one.
The synchronized contract records the long-exact-sequence kernel, the I/I^2 calculation, and the dimension mismatch.
The repaired disposition records that the former refutation asserted failure beyond the principal-ideal case without an example.
